objective: Creator can inspect/edit a Scene at 390x844 with at least a 370px rendered canvas height, compact selection controls, no horizontal document overflow, and reachable scene/timeline/Inspector controls; preserve existing Studio design and desktop behavior. Exact room-feature coordinates belong to Engineering; construction checks belong to Spatial context.
reviewOrder: All 19 PNG screenshots and complete-duration recording samples were inspected before reading layout/renderer receipts or repository workflow. No implementation source or builder rationale was inspected.
scope: Bounded phone correction only, with supplied desktop continuity/recovery/motion evidence as supporting context.
samplingMethod: Decoded all 1000 frames from four 25fps recordings, then visually inspected every fifth frame (0.2-second intervals) and each final frame using timestamped contact sheets. 8.72s + 4.00s + 17.88s + 9.40s = 40.00s total recording coverage. Native PNGs supplied full-size detail. Meaningful transitions include initial loading, camera change/isolation, renderer loss/retry/recovery, normal repeated cinematic takes, reduced motion, timeline changes, phone resize/scroll, and construction correction/save/reload.

dimensionObservations.observation: The phone Scene occupies a dedicated central column between narrow tool rails. The 370px canvas and compact selection strip sit above the timeline rather than competing with an open desktop sidebar. The Spatial context panel fills the available center column when opened. Desktop screenshots retain the broad canvas plus inspector composition.
dimensionObservations.unobserved: Other phone widths, orientation changes, browser chrome insets, and simultaneous unusual panel combinations were not inspected.

dimensionObservations.observation: Scene identity and saved revision remain above editing controls. Within Spatial context, Bedroom, room features, room dimensions, and construction checks form a readable sequence. The selected object strip offers isolate/edit actions without obscuring the room.
dimensionObservations.unobserved: Long localized Scene names and multiple selection hierarchy were not covered.

dimensionObservations.observation: Phone headings and body copy remain readable in the supplied native-size PNGs. Construction review text wraps inside its card; units and numeric values are legible. The compact selected-object name truncates while adjacent contextual actions remain visible. Existing small toolbar/footer text is dense but no new text collision prevents the bounded journey.
dimensionObservations.unobserved: No text enlargement, alternate font loading, translation, or measured readability study was performed.

dimensionObservations.observation: The phone canvas is separated from the selected-object card and timeline; panel controls and construction cards maintain internal padding. The construction finding and its reference-desk action fit within the center column without overlap.
dimensionObservations.unobserved: Touch comfort and large operating-system font settings cannot be established from screenshots.

dimensionObservations.observation: The phone shows compact scene selection/move/rotate/scale/grid controls in one row, visible panel rails, an edit-selected-object action, and timeline play/restart/stop controls after scroll. The construction recording reaches feature selection, engineering numeric editing, save, reload, and Spatial context results.
dimensionObservations.unobserved: Icon comprehension and physical touch target success were not tested. The timeline toolbar is dense; the finite evidence does not show an unreachable required control.

dimensionObservations.observation: Light labels, field outlines, and blue active states are visually distinguishable against the dark Studio panels. Focused numeric inputs have a prominent pale-blue outline; construction warning text and its action remain readable.
dimensionObservations.unobserved: No numerical WCAG contrast calculation, color vision simulation, or display brightness study was performed.

dimensionObservations.observation: Phone controls preserve the desktop dark panels, blue outlines, rounded controls, Scene identity banner, and tool-rail symbols. Spatial context uses the same construction finding language and grouping across desktop and phone.
dimensionObservations.unobserved: No whole-Studio or cross-product design audit was performed.

dimensionObservations.observation: The media distinguish draft opened/saved revisions, unsaved edits, renderer preparation, unavailable rendering with retry, recovered rendering, review finding, and corrected/reloaded zero findings. These states provide concrete feedback rather than silently replacing the screen.
dimensionObservations.unobserved: Network, authentication expiration, persistence failure, empty feature sets, and all adverse states remain outside observed coverage.

dimensionObservations.observation: At 390x844 the phone composition visibly fits the document width, supports vertical scrolling to canvas, timeline, and Spatial context, and replaces desktop sidebar competition with a center panel. The supporting layout receipt reports canvas 294x370, selection card 294x48.5, and horizontalOverflow 0. The 370px criterion is canvas height, not width.
dimensionObservations.unobserved: Only this emulated Chromium phone size is evidenced. No physical iPhone, Safari, dynamic address bar, onscreen keyboard, landscape, or broader breakpoint qualification.

dimensionObservations.observation: The visual experience retains labeled fields and buttons and the desktop Scene graph supplies selection shortcut guidance. Media-only review cannot establish keyboard traversal or activation. No keyboard success is claimed.
dimensionObservations.unobserved: Tab order, keyboard activation, escape behavior, screen-reader semantics, focus trapping, and all-keyboard completion are unobserved.

dimensionObservations.observation: A blue focus outline is visibly present on the edited feature Y field and later phone numeric edits, making the active edit location apparent. This proves the rendered focused state only.
dimensionObservations.unobserved: How focus arrived, retention across phone panel changes/reload, focus order, and keyboard-only visibility are not proven.

dimensionObservations.observation: The selected object strip reports in-view placement and links directly to editing. Construction checks distinguish one review finding from zero findings after correction/reload, while retaining the note that physical accessibility and rendered appearance still need review. Saved revision and unsaved indicators remain visible.
dimensionObservations.unobserved: Latency expectations, failed-save feedback, and announcement behavior are unobserved.

dimensionObservations.observation: All four recordings were sampled through the complete duration at 0.2s intervals plus final frame. Normal cinematic takes show progressive object position/playhead changes while the surrounding Studio stays stable; the reduced-motion interval and reduced-motion PNG keep the item visibly in view. Camera manipulation and recovery restore visible geometry without replacing the draft. Renderer receipt supports submitted normal-take transforms and reduced-motion in-view pose. No obvious jump or layout flash attributable to this bounded phone correction was observed in sampled frames.
dimensionObservations.unobserved: Sampling is 5Hz of 25fps recordings, not continuous playback or frame-perfect temporal measurement. It cannot exclude sub-200ms artifacts, prove physical-device frame rate, or establish subjective motion comfort.

dimensionObservations.observation: Selected-object identity and the draft remain visible across camera recovery; the construction sequence edits the reference desk, saves, reloads, returns to Spatial context, and shows zero findings. The phone Scene/timeline sequence is a scroll of the same Studio page, maintaining context.
dimensionObservations.unobserved: No multi-session, offline, concurrent-editor, or back-navigation continuity was tested.

dimensionObservations.observation: The compact phone selection strip exposes the current object and direct edit action without reproducing the full desktop selected-object card. Construction checking stays with Spatial context, and exact room-feature coordinates appear in the Engineering editing sequence. The correction preserves the established Studio structure while reducing competing phone overlays.
dimensionObservations.unobserved: Novice usability, full task discoverability, and all authoring modes are not qualified; the review does not certify every pre-existing timeline editor.

dimensionObservations.observation: Within the supplied synthetic Creator journey, the Creator can see the Scene at the required canvas height, reach selected-object editing and timeline controls by scrolling, inspect Spatial construction findings, edit room-feature values in Engineering, save/reload, and revisit corrected findings. This is bounded local rendered evidence.
dimensionObservations.unobserved: No real-person usability acceptance, owner acceptance, physical hardware, AR tracking, or live-provider outcome is claimed.

dimensionObservations.observation: Renderer failure displays a clear message with retry plus scene hierarchy/precise inspector/Guided View alternatives; the recovered state restores the object while keeping the inspector. Construction results explicitly preserve physical and visual review obligations even when checks report no findings.
dimensionObservations.unobserved: Phone-specific renderer failure, retry failure, offline fallback, screen-reader fallback, and Guided View completion were not observed.

limitations: Independent LOCAL review only; not trusted/formal Sounding Line capture, qualification, protected integration, or owner acceptance.
Screenshots and sampled recordings cannot prove keyboard, assistive technology, physical-device touch, iPhone/Safari, GPU hardware, AR tracking, or motion-comfort outcomes.
No whole-Studio certification. No claim that all existing behavior is free of unrelated debt.
No server launched; no protected capture or qualification run; repository and shared runtime state left unchanged.
No accepted earlier visual baseline was supplied; preservation was assessed against the supplied desktop/phone visual family and visible continuity, not by an exact before/after pixel comparison.
Source identity comes from the immutable source-bound supplied receipts; no independent build provenance attestation was performed.
